title: Whole Grain Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Seafood and Vegetables, Ready‑to‑Heat

content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain pasta with a tomato‑based sauce, seafood (shrimp, mussels) and added vegetables (bell pepper, zucchini, carrot) is a ready‑to‑heat meal that only needs warming. The combination of fiber‑rich pasta, flavorful sauce and marine protein makes it a balanced, nutritious option.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole grain pasta provides more fiber and micronutrients than refined‑wheat pasta.
Tomato sauce is rich in lycopene, an antioxidant that supports heart health.
Seafood is an excellent source of omega‑3 fatty acids, beneficial for brain function.
The vegetables retain most of their vitamins thanks to the quick cooking process.
The dish is designed for microwave or stovetop heating in 3–5 minutes.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole grain pasta helps regulate digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Complete protein source
items.content: Seafood combined with whole grain pasta supplies all essential amino acids.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Lycopene from tomatoes and vitamins from vegetables combat free radicals.

items.title: Omega‑3 fatty acids
items.content: Seafood provides beneficial polyunsaturated fats that support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: The meal contains vitamin C, vitamin A, iron and magnesium, important for immunity and energy.

items.title: Seafood allergy
items.content: People allergic to fish or shellfish may react; always check the ingredient list.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Tomato sauce and seafood can contribute notable sodium; monitor portion size if you watch blood pressure.

items.title: Heat handling
items.content: Overheating may dry out the pasta; follow the heating instructions.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meal in the microwave (2–3 minutes) or on the stove, stirring halfway. Serve immediately; optionally garnish with fresh basil or grated Parmesan.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0 °C–4 °C and consume within 5 days after opening. Freezing is not recommended as it may alter the texture of the seafood.
